title: Ghost
description: A flight's ghost: its logs' trajectories on one clock in one frame, as the JSON writes it.

frame.description: The frame in words: east, north and up from the pad, in meters.

tool.title: Tool
tool.description:
The program that wrote a document or a file: the title block every `--json` document, every
file `hpr` writes and `hpr --version` carry (ADR-164; the product system's `data.md`: "Every
export carries the designation and version of the tool that made it").

designation.description: Its designation in the FusionSpace product system: `FS-ACHERNAR · SW · TOOL 001`.

clock_back.description: Left out: the clock didn't go forward.

given.description: The rows of the log's latitude and longitude columns.

not_a_place.description: Left out: an empty cell, not a place, or a receiver's zero.

out_of_reach.description: Left out: past [`REACH_M`] from the median.

too_fast.description: Left out: too fast from the last kept ([`FASTEST_M_S`]).

first_fix_after_liftoff_s.description:
For [`PadFrom::FirstFix`], how long after liftoff that fix was, s; `None` when it wasn't
after, or no liftoff is known.

height_m.description:
Height above sea level or the ellipsoid, m, as the receiver or the caller states it; `None`
when no one states it.

latitude_deg.description: Latitude, degrees north; `None` when no log holds a place.

longitude_deg.description: Longitude, degrees east; `None` when no log holds a place.

PadFrom.description: Where the pad's place came from.

oneOf.description: The median of the last fixes before liftoff.

The first fix: no log holds one before liftoff, or none has a liftoff. The rocket may
already have left: [`Pad::first_fix_after_liftoff_s`] says by how long, where it can.
No log holds a place: east and north are of nothing, and each drawn at 0.

east_m.description: East of the pad at each moment, m; `null` before the first fix and after the last.

heights_too_fast.description: The log's rows left out for a height no flight could reach ([`FASTEST_M_S`]).

liftoff_bound_s.description:
The bound on the liftoff's error, s, when one was read. It is every moment's bound on this
timeline.

liftoff_s.description: The liftoff on the log's own clock, s, when one was read.

logger.description: The logger the log's format names, as a person reads it.

moments_left_out.description: The log's rows left out for a clock that didn't go forward, or a height not a number.

name.description: The log's name, as the caller gave it.

north_m.description: North of the pad at each moment, m; `null` as for east.

synced.description: Whether [`Track::time_s`] counts from the log's liftoff; if not, it is the log's own clock.

time_s.description: The moments kept, each later than the last, s.

up_m.description: Height above the pad at each moment, m; `null` when unknown.

widest_fix_gap_s.description: The widest time between two kept fixes, s; east and north are a straight line across it.

UpFrom.description: Where a track's height came from.

oneOf.description: The log's altitude as it wrote it.
The GNSS altitude less the pad's.
The log holds no height: each is `null`, and drawn at 0.
